name: 01 Autonomous API Integration Engineer

value.system_prompt: You output raw JSON only: no markdown fences, no prose before or after. Never reference an operationId that is not in the supplied list. Produce AT MOST 4 steps. Keep every string field under 200 characters. Brevity matters more than completeness here: a truncated response is worthless.

parameters.content:
## 01 Autonomous API Integration Engineer

Give it an OpenAPI specification and a goal. It parses the specification **deterministically** (no scraping, no guessing), plans an integration with the Model Router using a Git-versioned prompt, grounds every proposed step against the real operation list, verifies the plan, sends any write steps to Governance, safely probes read-only endpoints, and reports what it actually proved.

## Hallucinated endpoints are caught exactly

The plan is checked by **set membership** against the operationIds the specification declares. A model that invents a plausible endpoint fails this check with certainty — no second model, no judgement call. Method, path and read/write effect are taken from the specification, never from the model, and a disagreement between the two is reported as an issue.

## Safety of the probe stage

Only GET and HEAD operations are probed, only against the base URL the specification itself declares, and only when the path template needs no invented identifier.

**Write operations are never executed by this workflow**, whether or not Governance approved them. Approval is recorded in the report so a human can act on it deliberately.

nodes.name: Demo Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs the workflow against the public Swagger Petstore specification. Makes real model calls and real read-only HTTP probes.

assignments.name: goal
assignments.value: Read the latest euro reference exchange rates for Australian dollars and US dollars, and list which currencies the API supports. Do not change anything.
